name: Grid Frequency and BESS Response Bidirectional Droop Coupling
description: Grid frequency nadir and BESS active power response are bidirectionally coupled through the droop control law. Identity-bidir UPR: frequency drop triggers BESS response and vice versa.

elements.name: Grid Frequency Nadir
elements.description: Minimum grid frequency following an N-1 generation loss event.

uncertainty.source: power-grid-frequency.org (osf.io/m43tg): Continental European frequency nadir statistics

elements.name: Minimum Frequency Limit
elements.description: ENTSO-E: FCR activation threshold — BESS must maintain frequency above 49.3 Hz (tighter than UFLS at 49.0 Hz)

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ₁₂(f) = f, σ₂₁(P_bess) = (f_nom - f)/R — bidirectional droop coupling between frequency and BESS power
consistency_relations.upr_description: Identity-bidir UPR: frequency nadir and BESS response are bidirectionally linked through the droop control law.
